method: For each opposed rendered face normal at its native barycentre, bisect its longest non-boundary native edge. Both incident triangles share the same mapped midpoint. Sequentially split all marked edges in source winding order. At most 16 rounds, 5000 vertices and 10000 triangles per patch. Recompute analytic mapping/Jacobian at every new centre; select the lexicographic best (total opposed, root opposed, maximum centre gap) among tested rounds. Original source corners and six boundary edges are never moved or split.

limits: Conforming topology does not imply correct geometric orientation or anatomical accuracy
Neighbor fan orientation alerts are preserved and displayed, never hidden
Shared index identity is exact; outer corners have recorded float32 storage rounding
Patches overlap their unchanged coarse cortex in this diagnostic preview; no production replacement
Independent previews may overlap each other; they are not a single unified mesh
Sampled centre checks do not certify full interiors, volume, global injectivity or self-intersections
No acquired microstructures, neuronal activity or biological latency added
Finite adaptive attempts with a fixed outer contour may retain orientation alerts; failure is recorded, not smoothed away
Passing sampled orientations does not prove all triangle interiors, global injectivity or freedom from self-intersections
Native coordinates and per-triangle original source owners are supplied for independent reproduction; they remain synthetic points, not acquired anatomy
